2610.13456.title: Towards Enriching Design-Time Models with Evidence from Simulation and Operational Activities
2610.13456.paper_summary: Cyber-Physical Systems are developed through multiple model based activities, comprising several stages of development. As the development progresses through simulation, experimentation, and operation, observations of system execution may reveal missing, uncertain, or invalid design knowledge. The path from execution results to persistent design-time enrichment, however, is often implicit. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing an evidence driven workflow for systematically transferring knowledge produced during simulation and operation back into design-time models. We demonstrate the workflow using an Influence Model, a design-time artefact used to represent how design artefacts and environmental factors jointly affect system response properties, using a sign-following robot use case. We show how simulation evidence can enrich Influence Models by supporting participant pruning decisions, interaction characterisation, influence-function abstraction, and validity-scope information. The application demonstrates the feasibility of the workflow for simulation-based evidence and its potential benefits to improve design-time reasoning and feedback in subsequent development iterations.
2610.13456.paper_summary_zh: 網路物理系統是通過多個基於模型的活動開發而成，涵蓋了幾個開發階段。隨著開發通過模擬、實驗和運行的進展，系統執行的觀察可能會揭示缺失、不確定或無效的設計知識。然而，從執行結果到持久的設計時增強的過程往往是隱含的。本文通過提出一種基於證據的工作流程，系統地將模擬和運行過程中產生的知識轉回設計時模型，來應對這一挑戰。我們使用影響模型來演示該工作流程，這是一種設計時工件，用於表示設計工件和環境因素如何共同影響系統響應特性，並以跟隨標誌的機器人用例為例。我們展示了模擬證據如何通過支持參與者修剪決策、互動特徵化、影響函數抽象和有效範圍信息來豐富影響模型。該應用展示了基於模擬的證據工作流程的可行性及其在後續開發迭代中改善設計時推理和反饋的潛在好處。
